name: Kallang
summary: Central-east sports and stadium belt with Kallang Wave / indoor complex gravity, older HDB pockets, and shorter CBD hops than Tampines — block-level variance is everything.
body: Kallang sits on the central-east seam where stadiums, the indoor sports hub, and older HDB estates meet newer condo inserts toward the Kallang River. Expats shortlist it for ActiveSG / sports access and shorter CBD rides than far-east towns — not for Holland V café density. Housing mixes mature HDB, walk-ups, and newer condos; rents sit under River Valley for similar bedroom counts if you accept estate variance. Walk weeknights: event traffic, riverside humidity, and occasional pipe / road works chatter show up in forum threads. Compare with Bendemeer for quieter residential stacks beside the same broad catchment, Potong Pasir for quieter NELine-adjacent living, and Geylang when food density matters more than sports infrastructure.
